LESSON: NEWS TELLING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: LISTENING AND SPEAKING
Topic 1.2: News telling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers News telling, part of LISTENING AND SPEAKING in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: What do you usually see on your way to school? 2. What do you do when you are not in school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on News telling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Love: The learner accepts and respects others’ ideas as they tell news.

• Respect: The learner appreciates opinions of others while telling news.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: What do you usually see on your way to school? 2. What do you do when you are not in school?

Core Competencies:

• Communication and collaboration: The learner tells, retells and listens to news about happenings in the neighbourhood.

• Self-efficacy: The learner confidently tell news on things observed during a nature walk in their neighbourhood.

Values

• Love: The learner accepts and respects others’ ideas as they tell news.

• Respect: The learner appreciates opinions of others while telling news.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issue(
s) Social cohesion: The learner with others talk about the importance of neighbours as they live together in harmony.
